newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks weak, property shares underpinned.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks weak, property shares underpinned.

text.p: More selling of index-linked Cerebos Pacific and Fraser & Neaves at mid-morning on Thursday weighed on the Straits Times Industrials (STI) index, dealers said.
At 0230 GMT, the STI index was down 1.85 points at 1,991.64.
Cerebos was flat at S$6.75 after toughing S$6.60 while F&N fell S$0.10 to S$10.40.

The two food and beverage companies were being sold on expectations of weaker earnings, after Cerebos's disappointing first-half results and warning of a tough second-half. F&N's first-half results are due on Friday.
Foreign tranches of Singapore Press Holdings and local banks UOB and DBS eased as some institutions continued to adjust down their local portfolio. SPH Foreign eased S$0.30 to S$28.90.
Multimedia Creative Technology led losers, shedding S$0.50 to S$22.20.

The property index firmed 1.68 points to 692.27, underpinned by the government's announcement of strong bids for 99-year leasehold prime residential sites. City Development Ltd hit S$13.70 before easing back to S$13.60.
Dealers said they expected the support to be minimal and upside on property counters limited.
